fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kalista''' launches a spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
fields.description2: If ''Pierce'' kills the target, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the target's ''{{ai|Rend|Kalista}}'' stacks to the next enemy it hits.
